item.title: Mobile Veterinary Unit to Provide Low-Cost Pet Care in McPherson
item.description: MARSNAP is happy to partner with Bruce Veterinary Service to bring a mobile veterinary unit to Tractor Supply Co. in McPherson on February 18. This one day event will give local pet owners easy access to important veterinary care at low cost.

item.title: McPherson High School Adjusts Tournament Schedules Due to Winter Weather Concerns
item.description: McPherson High School has announced schedule changes for the 62nd Annual McPherson Invitational Tournament and the 31st Annual Mid America Classic because of concerns about winter weather and travel safety.

item.title: Six viruses detected at high levels in Kansas community's wastewater
item.description: LAWRENCE — Six viral diseases — including COVID-19, the flu and norovirus — have been found at high concentrations in Lawrence wastewater as Kansas communities face peak flu season.

item.title: Agritourism Grows Nationwide, Census Data Shows Rising Income and Wider Reach
item.description: Agritourism continues to expand across the United States, providing new income opportunities for farmers while strengthening rural communities, according to data from the USDA’s 2022 Census of Agriculture. Audrey Comerford of Oregon State University Extension said census data offers valuable insight into the scope and growth of agritourism nationwide.

item.description: Bitter cold weather was experienced by several parts of the nation at different times this winter. In some cases, the power outages caused by these conditions served as a reminder in food safety.
